label: Countdown timer
intent: The countdown is started. Light: the marker at 12 is pressed in with a click and springs back; on the click the remaining-time arc drains steadily from its tail toward 12, stops dead at the new time and catches; the time left stays. Strong: the marker lifts first and is pressed harder, and the arc counts down in three ticks, each a hit with a small catch, the last settling in two beats. The remaining time never drops below its new value. The reset fades the arc back to full.

remaining.//: anchored at 12, clockwise to 9: 270 degrees; the result keeps 150 (draw 5/9)

reverse.//: only the arc changed; the marker ends at rest, so it stays visible

marker.y.//: pressed into the dial's rim; 1.2 at most, so it never touches the arc's start at 12
